mainEntity.name: What do I need to start with a new sauna?

acceptedAnswer.text: At minimum: a bucket and ladle for making steam, a thermometer and a sand timer. Our Starter package covers the bucket, ladle and thermometer and adds eucalyptus essence. The Deluxe and Supreme packages add a sand timer and backrests. Every package is 10% off the individual prices.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver accessories across Ontario?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We ship accessories anywhere in Ontario; shipping is quoted by phone based on your order and location. If you are buying a sauna from us, we can bring your accessories with your sauna delivery and set them up on installation day.

mainEntity.name: Can I see the accessories before I buy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Visit our showroom at 17380 Highway 27, Schomberg (King Township), ON L0G 1T0. Visits are by appointment; call (437) 429-6623 to book.
Unused accessories in their original packaging can be returned. Processing fees and shipping costs are deducted from your refund. Contact us before sending anything back so we can arrange the return.

mainEntity.name: Which heater control do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: HUUM electric heaters need a HUUM UKU control: choose Wi-Fi for app control or Local for an in-sauna panel only. Homecraft heaters run through a contactor and touchpad; pick the indoor or outdoor version to match where your sauna sits, and Wi-Fi if you want to start it from your phone.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a safety railing around my heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is not required, but we recommend one for families and for smaller saunas where knees and elbows are close to the heater. HUUM makes fitted railings for the Drop and HIVE Mini.

mainEntity.name: What accessories suit a barrel sauna?

acceptedAnswer.text: A curved ceiling heat shield above the heater, a cedar backrest or two, a floor mat, and a bucket, ladle and thermometer. Wood-fired barrels pair well with a cedar firewood barrel or a Narvi wood basket.

mainEntity.name: Are LED lights safe inside a sauna?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every light we carry is made for sauna heat and humidity. The SaunaScapes Sade RGB sets and the Kaiku sound system carry a 2-year warranty, and the Electric Sauna Light is marine-grade.

mainEntity.name: What is soapstone, and why use it?

acceptedAnswer.text: A dense Finnish stone that absorbs heat slowly and releases it gently, which makes it ideal for steam stones, aroma cups and thermometers.

mainEntity.name: How do I look after the cedar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use Meldos sauna oil on interior cedar and Livos oil on the exterior. Left untreated, cedar weathers to a silver-grey that many owners love.
